chapter_seo_title: Seven Heavenly Steles Crush the Otherworld - World of Immortality Ch. 671
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen unleashes the seven Heavenly Steles, shattering the Nine-Nine Stone Steps and the blood altar. Ancestral gods Suiren, Fuxi, and Shennong return with armies as the white bone army invades.
og_title: Seven Heavenly Steles Annihilate the Otherworld
og_description: The ultimate war escalates as Xiao Chen uses the seven steles to destroy the enemy's sacred stronghold. Ancient heroes return and Lu Zhan summons the First Sacred City.
twitter_title: Seven Steles Descend Upon the Otherworld
twitter_description: Xiao Chen crushes the Nine-Nine Stone Steps with seven Heavenly Steles. Ancestral gods and white bone armies join the battle as Lu Zhan calls for the First Sacred City.
